notes.title: Planisphere on Steam
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342102/80830ef644b957d9ee7fe81b2aecd623899eb991.png[/img]
Planisphere is now available on Steam!

We hope everyone enjoys discovering constellations and building their own stories in the sky!

notes.title: Steam Launch Delay
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342102/80830ef644b957d9ee7fe81b2aecd623899eb991.png[/img]
The launch of Planisphere on Steam will be slightly delayed as the pricing needs to be updated so that the game is free. It was originally meant to be a paid game but throughout development we decided to release it for free instead.

Once the Steam pricing is updated the game will go live immediately so stay tuned!

notes.title: Planisphere is Releasing on December 31st
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342102/80830ef644b957d9ee7fe81b2aecd623899eb991.png[/img]

Planisphere will be releasing on December 31st on Steam!

We're excited to see what constellations folks find and create in the game!
